recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Do not add new XDS/XCA core connection-type codes for this seed; future Endpoint connection terminology changes should use later Endpoint/IHE tracker work or IHE mCSD vocabulary rather than reopening the applied FHIR-12342 cardinality decision.
issue_request: FHIR-12342 reported that endpoint-connection-type values did not capture XDS/XCA endpoint distinctions correctly. Its Published/Persuasive with Modification resolution was to change Endpoint.connectionType from 1..1 to 1..* rather than add separate core codes for each IHE transaction.
initial_application: No local source commit explicitly names FHIR-12342. The approved connectionType cardinality change was applied through the tightly related FHIR-34261 implementation commit 445d4741d1559c197decca8343f60d1cad753d36, which changed Endpoint.connectionType max to * and added explanatory text for multiple connection types.
additional_context: Endpoint is active in source/fhir.ini. Related FHIR-34261, FHIR-36589, FHIR-25393, and FHIR-40247 are already represented on the combined branch, so no opportunistic duplicate commits were published. Later FHIR-36589 changed connectionType to CodeableConcept with an example binding and IHE mCSD context, and FHIR-36327 later left the minimum cardinality at 1.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. The current source has Endpoint.connectionType min=1 max=* as CodeableConcept with an example binding, and the XCA example demonstrates multiple connectionType repetitions using IHE mCSD codes.
